profile.positioning:
Amir Santos is the Founder & CEO of FlowState Logistics, a SaaS platform revolutionizing supply chain management for the rapidly growing e-commerce SME market. We empower businesses to optimize their logistics, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction through real-time visibility and predictive analytics.  Having spent years advising Fortune 500 companies on supply chain strategy at Bain & Company, I recognized a significant gap in the market: these powerful tools were inaccessible to the businesses that needed them most. 

FlowState Logistics addresses this head-on, offering a user-friendly, affordable solution that levels the playing field. Our platform integrates seamlessly with existing e-commerce platforms and provides actionable insights into inventory levels, shipping times, and potential disruptions.  We are currently finalizing our MVP and preparing for a public beta launch in Q1 2024. 

We're laser-focused on serving e-commerce businesses generating between $1M and $20M in annual revenue, who are struggling with increasing shipping costs and supply chain complexities.  Early traction has been promising, with several pilot customers already demonstrating a 15-20% reduction in logistics spend after implementing our beta features. We're now actively seeking seed funding to accelerate product development and expand our sales and marketing efforts.  We believe FlowState Logistics is poised to become the leading supply chain solution for the next generation of e-commerce entrepreneurs.

• **Relevant Skills:** Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Data Analytics, Predictive Modeling, Strategy Consulting, Project Management, Lean Manufacturing, Process Improvement, SaaS, Business Development, Fundraising, Team Leadership, Financial Modeling.
profile.lookingFor:
I'm actively seeking to expand my network with individuals who can contribute to the growth of FlowState Logistics. My priorities are threefold: securing seed funding, onboarding strategic pilot partners, and building a strong advisory board.

• **Pilot Partners:** E-commerce businesses generating between $1M and $20M in annual revenue, currently experiencing pain points related to shipping costs, inventory management, or supply chain visibility.  Ideal profiles are companies selling physical products, with a focus on apparel, consumer electronics, or home goods. I’m particularly interested in companies utilizing Shopify or similar platforms.

• **Angel Investors & Early-Stage VCs:**  Investment firms with a demonstrated track record of supporting SaaS companies, particularly those focused on supply chain technology or e-commerce enablement.  I’m looking for investors who can provide not only capital but also strategic guidance and industry connections.

• **Supply Chain & Logistics Experts:**  Individuals with deep expertise in supply chain management, logistics, or data analytics who are interested in joining our advisory board.  We're seeking advisors who can provide valuable insights into industry trends, best practices, and potential market opportunities.

• **Mentors:**  Experienced founders who have successfully launched and scaled SaaS businesses. I’m eager to learn from their experiences and gain guidance on navigating the challenges of building a startup.  Specifically, I’m interested in connecting with founders who have raised seed funding and successfully launched a product.  I'm open to informal mentorship opportunities.
